sections.title: The affliction and sorrow of Jerusalem.

verses.text: አሌፍ። ሕዝብ ሞልቶባት የነበረች ከተማ ብቻዋን እንዴት ተቀመጠች!
ቤት። በሌሊት እጅግ ታለቅሳለች፤
ጋሜል። ይሁዳ ስለ ውርደቷና ስለ ባርነቷ ብዛት ተሰደደች፤
ዳሌጥ። ወደ ዓመት በዓል የሚመጣ የለምና የጽዮን መንገዶች አለቀሱ፤
ሄ። ስለ ኀጢአቷ ብዛት እግዚአብሔር አዋርዶአታልና
ዋው። ከጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ውበት ሁሉ ተወስዶአል፤
ዛይ። ኢየሩሳሌም ቀድሞ ወድዳ በሠራችው ሥራ ሁሉ የመከራዋን ወራት አሰበች፤
ሔት። ኢየሩሳሌም እጅግ ኀጢአት ሠርታለች፤ ስለዚህ ረክሳለች፤
ጤት። ግዳጅዋ ከእግርዋ በታች ነበረ፤ ፍጻሜዋን አላሰበችም፤
ዮድ። አስጨናቂው በምኞቷ ሁሉ ላይ እጁን ዘረጋ፤
ካፍ። ሕዝብዋ ሁሉ እንጀራ አጥተው ያለቅሳሉ፤
ላሜድ። እናንተ መንገድ ዐላፊዎች ሁሉ! በእናንተ ዘንድ ምንም የለምን?
ሜም። ከላይ እሳትን ሰደደ፤ አጥንቶችንም አቃጠለ፤
ኖን። በእጄ ስለተታቱ ኀጢአቶች ተጋ፤
ሳምኬት። እግዚአብሔር ኀያላኖችን ሁሉ ከመካከሌ አስወገዳቸው፤
ዔ። የሚያጽናናኝ፥ ነፍሴንም የሚመልሳት ከእኔ ርቆአልና ዐይኔ ውኃ ያፈስሳል።
ፌ። ጽዮን እጅዋን ዘረጋች፤ የሚያጽናናትም የለም፤
ጻዴ። ቃሉን አማርሬአለሁና እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው።
ቆፍ። ወዳጆችን ጠራሁ፤ እነርሱም ቸል አሉኝ፤
ሬስ። አቤቱ! ተጨንቄአለሁና፥ አንጀቴም ታውኮብኛልና ተመልከት፤
Behold, I have heard as one who is weary; there is none to comfort me.
Truly, my sorrow is great, and my heart is faint within me.

sections.title: The Lord brought forth His wrath upon Jerusalem.

verses.text: አሌፍ። እግዚአብሔር በቍጣው መቅሠፍት የጽዮንን ሴት ልጅ ምንኛ አጠቈራት!
ቤት። እግዚአብሔር የያዕቆብን መልካም ነገር ሁሉ አሰጠመ፤ አልራራምም፤
ጋሜል። በጽኑ ቍጣው የእስራኤልን ቀንድ ሁሉ ቀጠቀጠ፤
ዳሌጥ። ቀስቱን እንደ ተቃዋሚ ጠላት ገተረ፤ እንደ ባላጋራም ቀኝ እጁን አጸና፤
ሄ። እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጠላት ሆነብኝ፤ እስራኤልን አሰጠመ።
ዋው። ማደሪያውን እንደ ወይን ጋረደ፤ በዓሉን ሁሉ አጠፋ፤
ዛይ። እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያውን ጣለ፤ መቅደሱንም ጠላው፤
ሔት። እግዚአብሔር የጽዮንን ሴት ልጅ ቅጥር ያፈርስ ዘንድ ዐሰበ፤
ጤት። በሮችዋ በመሬት ውስጥ ሰጠሙ፤ መወርወሪያዎችዋም ተሰበሩ፤
ዮድ። የጽዮን ሴት ልጅ ሽማግሌዎች ዝም ብለው በመሬት ላይ ተቀምጠዋል፤
Woe. The child and the breast that is sought are in the streets of the city, as they cry out.
Alas. In the streets of the city, as a man is slain, in that time they have fallen.
Mem. O daughter of Jerusalem, what shall I testify unto thee? What shall I liken thee unto?
Non. Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee; they have not discovered thine iniquity.
Samket. All the wayfarers have laid their hands upon thee; they have beset thee.
E. All thine enemies have opened their mouths against thee; they have not held back.
Fe. The Lord hath done that which He hath devised; He hath fulfilled His word that He had commanded in the days of old.
Tsade. Their heart cried unto the Lord.
Kof. Arise; in the night, in the beginning of the watches, lift up thy voice.
Resh. O Lord, behold; consider whom hast Thou thus spoken?
San. Blessed are those who are hidden in the ways;
Taw. Call upon me as one calls upon a festival day, from around me;
I am the one who has seen trouble in His wrath.
The light has departed from me and darkness has overwhelmed me.
Every day He turns His hand against me.
O house, He has stripped my flesh and my sacrifice; He has broken my bones.
Surround me with a wall; and make the path of my affliction known to me.
Like the dead of old, He has made me dwell in darkness.
As one who does not go out, surround me with a wall; and honor my prayer.
In the time I called and cried out, my prayer was hindered.
He has made my way a path in the world; and He has laid waste my road.
Let me be as a bear robbed of her cubs, as a lion that has been ensnared.
ተከተለኝ፤ ጨረሰኝ፤ ባድማም አደረገኝ።
ቀስቱን ገተረ፤ ለፍላጻውም እንደ ዒላማ አደረገኝ።
ሄ። የሰገባውን ፍላጻዎች በኵላሊቴ ውስጥ ተከለ።
ለወገኔ ሁሉ መሳቂያ ሆንሁ፤ ቀኑንም ሁሉ ዘፈኑብኝ።
ምሬትን አጠገበኝ፤ በሐሞትም አሰከረኝ።
ዋው። ጥርሴን በጭንጫ ሰበረ፤ አመድም አቃመኝ።
ነፍሴን ከሰላም አራቀ፤ በጎ ነገርን ረሳሁ።
እኔም፦ ኀይሌን፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ያለውን ተስፋዬን አጣሁ።
ዛይ። ስደቴንና ችግሬን፥ እሬትንና ሐሞትን አስብ።
ነፍሴ እያሰበችው በውስጤ ፈዘዘች።
I have pondered this in my heart; therefore, I shall hope in it.
Indeed, it is by the mercy of the Lord that we are not consumed; for His compassion does not fail.
Morning, morning is new; Your faithfulness is great.
My soul says, "The Lord is my portion; therefore, I will wait for Him."
Goodness. The Lord is good to those who wait for Him;
For those who seek Him and for those who wait silently, the soul that hopes in the Lord is a good soul.
It is good for a man to bear the yoke in his youth.
He has borne it alone, so let him sit in silence.
Let hope be as it is, and let the mouth speak within the dust.
He will give to the one who is struck; He will also repay the one who is wronged.
For the Lord shall not forsake forever;
He who is grieved shall be comforted according to the multitude of his forgiveness;
My heart is not troubled, nor do I grieve for the children of man;
To the meek, let all who are oppressed upon the earth be lifted under His feet;
The judgment of man shall return before the Most High;
In the time of judgment, the judgment of man shall not be overturned, for the Lord shall not be silent.
"The Lord who is not silent shall come forth;
Who is he that says, 'A good word shall not come forth from the Most High's mouth, whether it be good or evil'?
Why does man, being alive, stumble because of his sin?
No. Let us examine our ways and search them; and let us return to the Lord our God.
Let us lift our hearts with our hands unto the Lord, unto heaven.
We have sinned; we have transgressed; yet Thou hast not turned away from us.
O Lord, in Thy wrath remember not our iniquities; do not forsake us; Thou hast not turned away from us.
Let our prayers not be hindered; let them ascend before Thee like a cloud.
That we may be gathered and that we may see, establish us among the nations.
O Lord, let all our adversaries open their mouths against us.
Fear and wrath, destruction and calamity have overtaken us.
For the sake of my people, the daughter of my kin, calamity has poured forth from mine eyes like a river.
O Lord, mine eyes are troubled; henceforth I shall not be silent in my lamentation.
The Lord from heaven shall look down until He beholds.
Concerning my city, all its desolations have made my soul sorrowful.
O Lord, in vain have all my adversaries surrounded me like birds of prey.
My enemies have encircled my life like a wall; they have pressed upon me like a stone above.
Upon myself, water has poured forth; and I said, "I am lost."
O Lord, in the depths of the pit, I called upon Your name.
You have heard my cry; do not turn away Your ear from my supplication.
On the day I called upon You, draw near to me; say unto me, "Fear not."
O Lord, judge the cause of my soul; redeem my life.
O Lord, do not disregard my affliction; judge my cause for me.
You have seen all their plots against me and all that is laid upon me.
O Lord, hear all their supplications and the thoughts that are upon me.
O Lord, hear the thoughts of those who rise against me and all who meditate upon me throughout the day.
Behold their sitting and their rising; I am their song.
O Lord, according to the work of their hands, let their reward be given to them.
Grant them the healing of the heart and your mercy.
O Lord, as their hearts are wicked, in your anger you shall destroy them; from heaven above, you shall bring them to ruin.
Aleph. How has gold become tarnished! The finest gold, how has it changed!
House. The daughters of Zion, who are esteemed, are like pure gold,
Camel. Though the beasts have revealed their hides, they have hidden their service;
Dalet. The breast that is sought by the child has been drawn away from the breast, and has been taken to the nurse;
He. Let those who have been forsaken eat, those who were on the way have perished;
Waw. No hand shall fall upon it, when the stone has been cast upon it,
Zayin. Her holy ones are more numerous than the snow; they are more numerous than the honey;
Het. Their faces are more disfigured than the coal; they are not known on the way;
Tet. Those who die by the sword are better than those who die from hunger;
Yod. The hands of the daughters of the righteous have forsaken their children;
ካፍ። እግዚአብሔር መዓቱን ፈጽሞአል፤ ጽኑ ቍጣውንም አፍስሶአል፤
ላሜድ። የምድር ነገሥታት፥ በዓለምም የሚኖሩ ሁሉ፥
ሜም። የጻድቃንን ደም በውስጥዋ ስላፈሰሱ፥
ኖን። እነርሱ ታውረው በመንገድ ላይ ተቅበዘበዙ፤
ሳምኬት። እናንተ ከርኩሳን ራቁ፥ አስተምሩአቸው፤ ራቁ፥ ራቁ በሉአቸው፤ አትንኩአቸውም።
ዔ። የእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፍላቸው ነበረ። ነገር ግን ከእንግዲህ ወዲህ አይመለከታቸውም፤
ፌ። በማያድን ወገን እያመንን ረዳታችን ከንቱ ስለ ሆነ፥
ጻዴ። ልጆቻችንን ወደ አደባባያችን እንዳይወጡ ከለከልን፤
ቆፍ። አሳዳጆቻችን ከሰማይ ንስር ይልቅ ፈጣኖች ሆኑ፤
ሬስ። ስለ እርሱ፥ “በአሕዛብ ውስጥ በጥላው በሕይወት እንኖራለን” ያልነው፥
Sing, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; rejoice greatly, and be glad.
Shout, O daughter of Zion; for thy transgressions have been atoned for; from henceforth thou shalt not remember them.

sections.title: A prayer offered for the attainment of mercy.

verses.text: O Lord, consider our plight;
Our inheritance has been given to another;
We have become as the destitute, for we have no father.
We have drunk our water for money;
Our adversaries have oppressed us;
The Egyptians and the Assyrians,
Our fathers committed iniquity, and now there is none left;
We have been made servants to them;
From the wilderness, the sword has arisen;
Our bodies have been afflicted by hunger.
O daughters of Zion,
The leaders have been captured in their hands;
The mighty have been taken captive;
The noblemen have been cast away from their dwelling;
The joy of our hearts has ceased;
Our crown has fallen;
Therefore, our hearts are faint;
For the mountain of Zion has become desolate;
O Lord, You reign forever;
Why do You forget us forever?
አቤቱ፥ ወደ አንተ መልሰን፤ እኛም እንመለሳለን፤
ፈጽመህ ጥለኸናልና፤
